free_tier.stated: Hobby is Free: tokens from the user's own ChatGPT or Claude subscriptions or own API keys carry no Amp token fees or limits, and runners on the user's own machine are free; Amp-hosted orbs are pay-as-you-go and nothing is included (Amp-served model usage is bought as credits at list price)
free_tier.notes: the agent costs nothing on the free path; the first thing that costs money is an Amp-hosted orb at the per-minute rate or an Amp-served model, never a linked subscription or own key

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a coding agent meters nothing itself

egress.terms: not applicable: the chosen endpoint or the user's own subscription serves the inference

interface_detail: the `amp` CLI. Headless: `amp -x "prompt"` (execute mode) sends the prompt, waits for the agent's turn to end, prints the final message and exits, and turns on by itself when stdout is redirected; `amp -ox` is shorthand for `--orb-execute -x` and starts the same prompt in an Amp-hosted orb, prints the thread URL and exits; `--stream-json` streams the events, locally or from an orb; `--executor runner:<id>` targets one of the user's own runners; scripts and CI set AMP_API_KEY to an access token from Settings that starts with `sgamp_`
tooling: the user installs and runs the amp CLI (macOS, Linux, or Windows through WSL) on a rented or free machine, or the user's own runner started with `amp --no-tui --runner-id <id>`; the web app and the macOS, iOS and Android apps run the agent in an Amp-hosted orb instead; models come from the user's linked ChatGPT subscription (`amp config model-providers add-chatgpt-subscription`), the Claude Code mode on a linked Claude subscription, or own API keys in Model Routing
chaining: hosted lanes first: an Amp-hosted orb on Hobby is pay-as-you-go from USD 0.08 an hour (a1.tiny), Amp-served models are bought as credits with no markup on provider API prices, and the paid Individual tier (coding-subs/amp-individual) bundles 45,000 orb minutes and USD 20 of agent usage; the free path links a ChatGPT subscription or any key in inference/ and runs the agent on the user's own runner

limits.value: orb spawn pacing: a burst of 20 metered orbs per user, then one new orb every five minutes; later orb starts wait instead of failing

limits_note: a linked ChatGPT subscription serves only OpenAI models and token sharing is not available on every ChatGPT plan (ChatGPT Business and Enterprise workspaces can turn it off); a linked Claude subscription covers only the Claude Code mode, and Amp's own modes and raw models are never covered by it; web search, web page reads, voice and image generation still use Amp credits; Amp-hosted orbs are not covered by a ChatGPT or Claude plan
binding_note: the free path (own subscription or key, own runner) has no Amp-side quota; the orb spawn pacing and the per-minute orb price apply only when Amp-hosted orbs are used

identity_cost.detail: the sign-up page offers an email address ('Continue with Email') or 'Sign in with ChatGPT'; a payment method for buying credits or Amp-hosted orb time is unverified: behind a sign-up (the pricing page states only that invoices are issued through Stripe)

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded; the earlier Amp Free daily credit grant has been paused or reduced for more users since the update dated 2026-05-23, and the Hobby row lists nothing included
confidence_note: tiers, prices, headless flags and routing are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-02. The sign-up flow past its first page, the payment method it asks for, and the access-token rules on Hobby are unverified: behind a sign-up. The ChatGPT and Claude subscription links are documented, not exercised.
